description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Context', which manages a registry of context variables, allowing registration, retrieval, destruction, existence check, and batch loading of variables within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Context
classes.description: A registry object that contains and manages context variables, providing methods to register, retrieve, destroy, verify existence, and load multiple variables in the context.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a variable by reference into the context with the specified name, throwing an exception if the name already exists.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the reference to a stored variable by name, optionally ignoring errors if variable not found.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes a variable from the context by name, throwing an exception if the variable does not exist.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a variable with the given name exists in the context.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads multiple variables into the context from an associative array.
